subject: Intro: Cerulean Health exec connect + demo logistics
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-25T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Cerulean Health exec connect + demo logistics

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro — we’re excited to see Redwood’s inference platform in action. On our side I’ll be coordinating with Leah Morgan (VP Product) and our CIO, Marcus Hale. They’re particularly keen to understand:
- latency and cost profiles for inference at 1k qps
- options for private/VPC deployment and audit logs
- support & SLA for Dedicated pools

Would you and your team be able to run a 45-minute demo + Q&A sometime next week? Preferable windows are:
- Tue 4/27 between 11:00–13:00 PT
- Wed 4/28 between 09:00–11:00 PT

If those won’t work we can be flexible; also happy to do a quick 15–20 minute pre-brief with your AE before the execs dial in.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Reynolds
Director, Strategic Accounts
Cerulean Health
alex.reynolds@ceruleanhealth.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@ceruleanhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Cerulean Health exec connect + demo logistics

Alex — great to meet you over email, thanks for sharing the scope. We can definitely cover latency/cost at scale and the Private deployment story.

Quick notes on capacity: for a 1k qps scenario we’ll want to show both a Hosted-to-Dedicated routing plan and the Private VPC latency profile; I’ll include a short demo flow that highlights real numbers and a fallback routing policy.

Proposed demo windows from our side (PT):
- Tue 4/27, 11:30–12:15 PT (45 min) — preferred if Leah can do mid-day
- Wed 4/28, 09:30–10:15 PT (45 min) — alternate

Marissa — can you hold the Tue 11:30 slot tentatively and prep the short deck + the agenda (we’ll attach a PDF)? Soojin — can you be on standby to cover any deep infra questions from Marcus if needed?

Alex — if Tue 11:30 works I’ll send the calendar invite and include a 20-minute pre-brief at 11:00 PT for our internal alignment / handoff.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-04-25T19:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Cerulean Health exec connect + demo logistics

Putting this on the calendar tentatively. Notes for the team:

Agenda (draft) — attached as demo-agenda.pdf- 5 min: intros & objectives (Ben / Alex)- 15 min: runtime demo (Marissa) — focused on 1k qps case, batching and KV cache benefits- 15 min: deployment options & security (Soojin) — VPC, KMS, audit logs- 10 min: pricing and next steps (Ben)

Backup plan: if Leah can’t join at 11:30 PT, we keep the demo and record it and schedule a 30-min follow-up with her for a focused SLA/contract chat.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (6 pages)
Calendar: I’ll prepare the invite after Ben confirms the final time.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks — Tue 4/27 11:30 PT works for Leah and Marcus. Confirming:
- Demo 11:30–12:15 PT (45 min)
- Pre-brief with Ben/Marissa 11:00–11:20 PT (internal)

I’ve attached the calendar invite (cerulean-demo-invite.ics) and updated the attendee list. One ask before the demo: can you include a one-slide appendix that shows our expected token volumes and an example SLO for S3 retention + audit logs? That’ll help Marcus during the Q&A.

On Tue I’ll dial in from 11:25 PT to set expectations and we’ll be ready to record. Looking forward to it.

—Alex
Alex Reynolds
Director, Strategic Accounts
Cerulean Health
